'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Chris Fanchi DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Fanchi]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Chris F
* '''Deck name:''' 2 balls-1= 7 titties hippo
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
